summary_en: Tsubakimoto Kogyo announced on October 30, 2026 a block acquisition of up to 300,000 shares (1.63% of outstanding shares) at a fixed price of 2,967 yen per share via ToSTNeT-3, totaling up to 890.1 million yen, to be executed on November 2, 2026 in the morning session.
title_en: Notice of Acquisition of Treasury Stock and Purchase of Treasury Stock through Off-Session Trading (ToSTNeT-3)
translation_en_brief:
On October 30, 2026, Tsubakimoto Kogyo's Board of Directors authorized an acquisition of treasury stock through off-session trading (ToSTNeT-3). The company will purchase up to 300,000 ordinary shares at a fixed price of 2,967 yen per share (the final closing price and best bid-ask spread on October 30) on November 2, 2026, in the morning session. The total acquisition amount is capped at 890.1 million yen, representing 1.63% of outstanding shares (based on 18,394,259 shares outstanding excluding treasury stock as of September 30, 2026).

The acquisition method is a single fixed-price block trade via ToSTNeT-3, with the purchase order limited to that trading session only. The company stated that market conditions could result in partial or no execution of the planned acquisition.

The company authorized this acquisition for two purposes: returning capital to shareholders and enhancing capital efficiency while enabling flexible and agile capital allocation decisions. As of September 30, 2026, the company held 1,099,648 treasury shares, including 272,500 shares held by an executive equity compensation trust.
